items.title: Discovery Loop
items.summary:
* **Title:** Discovery Loop Accelerates Scientific Breakthroughs with AI-Automated Experiment Cycles
* **Summary:** Discovery Loop utilizes cutting-edge AI models and a large-scale computing infrastructure to automate experiment cycles, enabling parallel execution of machine learning research, scientific discovery, and engineering tasks. The team, led by experts like Jeff Dean, aims to accelerate experimental iteration and address significant scientific challenges in areas such as clean energy, healthcare, and cybersecurity.

items.title: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is stepping down
items.summary:
* **Title:** DeepMind CEO Changes: Hassabis Transitions to Chairman, Core Scientist Team to Launch New Company

* **Summary:** Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis will step down from his CEO role and become Chairman, while core scientist Jeff Dean and several other Google AI colleagues will leave to establish a new company. Google will invest in the new company. This leadership change reflects Google’s significant internal restructuring and talent drain as it strives to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic.

items.title: The next chapter of our AI momentum
items.summary:
* **Title:** Google DeepMind Organizational Changes: Demis Hassabis Appointed as Alphabet Chief Scientist

* **Summary:** Google has announced significant changes within the DeepMind team. Demis Hassabis has been promoted to Alphabet Chief Scientist and will also serve as DeepMind Chairman. Koray Kavukcuoglu has been promoted to DeepMind Vice President. Additionally, Jeff Dean and Sanjay Ghemawat will jointly establish an independent, non-profit company focused on accelerating machine learning and scientific discovery. These changes are intended to strengthen Google’s efforts in AGI and at the forefront of scientific research, and to consolidate its comprehensive AI technology capabilities.

items.title: Jeff Dean leaving Alphabet
items.summary:
* **Title:** Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean Departing; AI Startup “Discovery Loop” Emerges

* **Summary:** Google’s Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and three key AI researchers are forming a new company called “Discovery Loop,” aiming to develop AI systems with recursive self-improvement capabilities. This move represents a shift in Google’s internal power structure, reflecting a trend of top AI talent moving to independent AI startups seeking greater autonomy and a more agile environment. The new company has secured investment from several venture capital firms and plans to operate under a public benefit corporation structure, balancing commercial interests with the societal value of scientific discovery.

items.title: Cops Used Flock to Track a Man Across State Lines for a Pretextual Weed Search
items.summary:
* **Title:** Wisconsin Police Use Flock to Track a Man Traveling Between Wisconsin and a Marijuana-Legal State for Drug Search
* **Summary:** Wisconsin police are using the Flock monitoring network to track a man who frequently travels between Wisconsin and a state where marijuana is legal. This data is being used to build a “justification” for searching his vehicle and seizing marijuana. This case highlights how law enforcement agencies are using surveillance technology to create legal justifications for minor offenses, raising concerns about privacy boundaries and potential misuse of monitoring power.

items.title: Qwen 3.0 Image Pro
items.summary:
* **Title:** Qwen 3.0 Image Pro Released: Industrial-Grade Image and Text Generation with High-Precision Rendering Capabilities

* **Summary:** The Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro model supports 4.5k image and text inputs, and features text rendering down to 10px and micro-expression reconstruction. It can generate complex layouts such as newspapers and menus. Utilizing prefix completion, function calling, caching optimization, and structured output, it provides a complete end-to-end productivity tool for concept to deployment.
